jeff-timeline · live demo

An embeddable web component that renders a parallel-tracks timeline against the Digital Jeff canon. Drop two lines into any modern browser-capable page and you have a working timeline: 

<script src="https://thejaylance.github.io/timeline-builder/v1/timeline.js"></script>
<jeff-timeline chart="career-map"></jeff-timeline>
